listing.name: GoldenEye 007: Reloaded — GoldenEye007ReloadedRecomp (nikolaygorb)
listing.summary: Upstream reports the main menu with video, audio and controller input, plus training and first-mission gameplay. Online multiplayer is not implemented. Its testing covers Windows; Linux and macOS build presets are untested. Portcove has not confirmed a campaign or platform compatibility. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Provide your own GoldenEye 007: Reloaded Xbox 360 complete extracted game files, including the original executable. Title 415608AF/media 40583A82.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Extract your own GoldenEye Reloaded ISO, then build with Clang and CMake. The build generates game code locally.
